definition.any_observation_name: at least one linked observation row, including rows from partial attempts and typed missing values
definition.authority: does not change cadence, freshness, batch size, universe, rights, historical availability or financial authority
definition.day: attempted_at UTC calendar day; every day from oldest retained receipt through cutoff included; zero means no retained attempts, not proof of a missed scheduled run
definition.denominator: union of the three incumbent constituent-file indexes at the frozen source revision; fixed comparator for this entire report, not asserted historical target membership
definition.hour_cycle: collection_session_id plus attempted_at UTC hour; long sessions may span buckets
definition.latency: attempt receipt latency_ms; p50/p95 use pandas linear interpolation over non-null finite values
definition.name_categories: daily name categories can overlap and must not be added
definition.outside_target: retained historical attempt ticker absent from the frozen current target; not classified as a source error
definition.successful_observation_name: at least one status=success attempt with observation_count > 0; typed missing fields can still occur; this is source operating coverage, not semantic/economic eligibility
